rule.measure: the money with the extra cost inside the path, from the shipped code at that level
rule.balanced: THE ANSWER. Among all books and levels: both years > 0 (each alone from Rs 2.5 lakh), at most one of the four half-years negative, at least 40 trades a year, the carried account's largest fall <= 25% of its running peak, no wipe-out. Highest worse-year net wins
rule.most_money: the highest carried two-year end, whatever the fall (shown with its fall)
rule.lowest_risk: the smallest carried fall with both years > 0
rule.peak_check: for each book, the level with the most money on 2025 alone and on 2026 alone, brakes off. A level is 'inside the margin' if it is at most half the smaller of those two (estimates err, and betting past the peak earns less: Kelly). The balanced pick is reported with this check
rule.cross_year: the same balanced rule chosen on 2025 alone (fall on 2025 only) and scored on 2026, and the reverse
rule.wipe_out: a carried account ending under Rs 10,000
rule.correctness: analyze_r.check_book on every replay: all closed, charges recomputed, entries per day, own cash, lots recomputed from the planner's formula (brakes off); SHIPPED|AS reproduces the stored rupees exactly; brakes-off levels compared with the O30s simulator; a sample replayed twice
rule.status: NIFTY 2025 and Jan - Oct 2026 are both seen, and the +rule books were found by looking at them. A pick is a candidate for the 2024 exam and forward data. Nothing in the system changes on this; the owner decides. The Nov 2 real-money test stays one lot.
